note: FIXTURE #1 — the case that motivated this engine. On the prior system this
query matched only the literal words and could not deduce that the theme
means 'hearing the word, then acting on it'.
Status 'pending' means: expected to fail until the Phase 2 concept layer
lands. The gauntlet reports pending fixtures separately and does NOT fail
the build on them, so the target is visible from day one without blocking
Phase 0 and 1 work. When Phase 2 admits the ontology, flip status to
'active' in the same PR that makes it pass.
PHASE 1 UPDATE (2026-07-29): the lexical ladder alone now returns
James 1:22, Luke 6:47 and Matthew 7:24 in the top three for this query,
because the tokenizer folds 'doing'->do and 'heareth'->hear. That is the
right VERSES for the wrong REASON: the evidence is token_overlap, not a
curated concept anchor, so the engine cannot yet say WHY these passages
belong together, and a query with no shared vocabulary (e.g. 'faith
without works') would still miss. The fixture stays pending until the
reasons are right, not merely the results.
PHASE 2 (2026-07-29): PROMOTED TO ACTIVE. The curated concept layer now
supplies concept_anchor evidence for all three anchors, so the engine can
say WHY these passages belong together and cite who says so. The gauntlet
detected this itself - it runs pending fixtures precisely so a target that
starts passing cannot go unnoticed.

mustNotRank.why: Contains no thematic relation; would indicate raw token noise ranking above concept evidence.
